name: 立替経費精算 (expense reimbursement)

references.title: A reimbursement of a business expense the employee paid is not remuneration (健康保険法 art.3(5): 労働の対償), not a wage and not salary income; it is paid outside gross pay against receipts.

name: 出張旅費 (business travel expenses)

references.title: 所得税法 art.9(1)(iv): travel expenses for business travel within what is ordinarily necessary are not taxable; not remuneration or wages.
